repos_data.description: Computer Experience Layer — MCP server for native computer use on macOS. Structured perception, reliable actions, continuous awareness.
Remote MCP server for Glasswarp — observe and control real Windows PCs

repo_meta_data.description: Windows computer-use MCP server: drive any desktop app via semantic discover-then-act targeting (entities + leases, not pixel coordinates), with per-action perception guards, a native Rust UIA engine, Chrome CDP, and Key Locker credential autofill for ssh/sudo password prompts. Works with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
